primary.title: What Is to Be Done?
primary.author: Vladimir Lenin
primary.rationale: A foundational text outlining Lenin's vision for the Bolshevik party and revolutionary strategy. Widely available.

primary.title: The State and Revolution
primary.author: Vladimir Lenin
primary.rationale: Lenin's theoretical work on the nature of the state and the necessity of proletarian revolution. A key Marxist text.

primary.title: April Theses
primary.author: Vladimir Lenin
primary.rationale: A series of directives issued by Lenin upon his return to Russia, outlining the Bolsheviks' immediate political goals. Often published in collections of his speeches and writings.

secondary.title: Lenin: A Biography
secondary.author: Robert Service
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive and widely respected scholarly biography of Lenin by a prominent historian.

secondary.title: Lenin's Tomb: The Last Days of the Soviet Empire
secondary.author: David Remnick
secondary.rationale: While focusing on the end of the Soviet Union, this book provides significant historical context and analysis of Lenin's legacy and impact.

secondary.title: The Cambridge Companion to Lenin
secondary.author: Tamás Krausz
secondary.rationale: A collection of essays by leading scholars offering diverse perspectives on Lenin's life, thought, and historical significance.

suggestions.notes: Primary sources are often found in collections of Lenin's works or speeches. Secondary sources are selected for their scholarly reputation and recency.
